services_section.label: WHAT WE HANDLE
services_section.heading: Pool Care That Works
services_section.subheading: From algae blooms to broken pumps — we handle what your pool throws at you.

services.title: Weekly Pool Cleaning
services.description: Complete pool maintenance including skimming, vacuuming, brushing walls, and emptying baskets to keep your pool crystal clear.

services.title: Chemical Balancing
services.description: Professional water testing and chemical treatment to maintain proper pH, chlorine levels, and water chemistry for safe swimming.

services.title: Equipment Repair
services.description: Expert diagnosis and repair of pool pumps, filters, heaters, and automation systems to keep your pool running smoothly.

services.title: Pool Opening & Closing
services.description: Seasonal services to properly open your pool for summer and winterize it for Ohio's cold months, protecting your investment.

services.title: Filter Cleaning
services.description: Thorough cleaning and maintenance of cartridge, sand, and DE filters to ensure optimal water circulation and clarity.

about.heading: Akron Pool Experts
about.body: We're an Akron pool service team that answers the phone and shows up when we say we will. One call handles your entire pool.
